_meta.purpose: routine id -> claude.ai RemoteTrigger id (trig_...), so a future session can call RemoteTrigger get/update/run directly without rediscovering IDs via Claude-in-Chrome.
_meta.provenance: 'api' = seen directly by a session via RemoteTrigger list/get/update (ground truth). 'chrome' = reported by Claude-in-Chrome only, not independently confirmed via the API.
_meta.caveat: IDs are stable for a trigger's lifetime, but this file is a point-in-time snapshot, not live-synced — if a trigger is deleted and recreated, its ID changes and this file goes stale. RemoteTrigger `list` pagination is broken in-session (always returns the same first ~20 of ~31+ routines regardless of cursor/limit), which is why this file exists as a workaround; if that's ever fixed, prefer a live `list` sweep over trusting this file blindly. CORRECTED 2026-09-07: that broken-pagination claim is specific to the `RemoteTrigger` tool. The separate `mcp__Claude_Code_Remote__list_triggers` tool paginates CORRECTLY (`has_more` / `next_cursor`) and returns the full live instruction in `derived_state.prompt` plus `allowed_tools`/`model`/`environment_id`, so a session holding it can sweep the whole fleet without this file and without per-id gets (measured: 35 of 35 triggers read; events.decision_log entry_type='trigger-audit', 2026-09-06 cycle).
_meta.excludes: 2 personal (non-trading) routines on the same account (video-generation research) are intentionally omitted — out of scope for this repo.
_meta.recreated_2026_08_01: D1, D2a, D2, D3, OPS0, OPS1, OPS2, M1a, SL2, SL3, SL5, AR_att and AR_orc were accidentally deleted from the web UI and RECREATED via RemoteTrigger create on 2026-08-01; their ids above are the NEW ones and every pre-2026-08-01 id for these 13 is dead (404). An API-created trigger stores a literal UTC cron, so the 9 formerly-DST-aware daily routines (D1, D2a, D2, D3, AR_att, AR_orc, SL2, SL5, SL3) are now FIXED-UTC tuned for MDT (UTC-6) and will fire 1h earlier in local time once MST begins (~2026-11-01) -- the same accepted caveat the monthly/quarterly cohort already carries. Re-pick them with the native Daily picker in the web UI to restore DST-awareness.
